Skill eval results

Each skill runs the same eval cases twice: with the skill loaded and with no skill at all. The score says how well the cases went with the skill, from 0 to 1. Δ says how much better that is than no skill. A skill is stable at a score of at least 0.80 and a Δ of at least +0.20 over 3 or more runs.

No eval results yet

This page lists each skill's with-skill score and its Δ against a no-skill baseline as soon as a redacted eval summary is committed. Until then it shows nothing, and it never estimates a number.

  1. Run a pack's eval cases with and without the pack, writing the raw result outside the repository: 
    claude plugin eval packs/<pack> --ablation with-without \
  --output-dir ../eval-results
  2. Redact aggregate-result.json into packs/<pack>/evals/results/<date>/summary.json and commit only that file. Raw results hold model identifiers and transcripts.
  3. Rebuild this page: 
    python3 tools/repo/site/build.py

The full steps, with cost limits and grader advice, are in Qualify a skill.

How to read this

Score with skill
The mean case score with the skill's plugin loaded, from 0 to 1. A run scores the share of its graders that passed, and a case scores the mean of its runs.
Δ vs no skill
The score with the skill minus the score of the same cases run with no plugin loaded. Above 0, the skill helped.
Runs
Runs per case in each arm, with and without the skill: the fewest any of the skill's cases got. One run of an agent is noisy, so the stable bar needs at least 3.
Stable bar
A score of at least 0.80 and a Δ of at least +0.20, with 3 or more runs per case in each arm, from a complete run on a pinned model that covers at least 3 of the skill's cases, with a Δ for each.
Regression
Δ at or below 0: the skill does no better than no skill. It gets reworked or retired, and the result stays published.
No baseline
The run had one arm only, so it has no Δ and can't qualify a skill.
Partial run
A run that stopped early, for example at its cost ceiling. Each skill uses its latest complete run; a partial run counts only when no complete run exists, and it is flagged.
Source
Redacted summaries committed under packs/<pack>/evals/results/ and labs/<pack>/evals/results/. Model identifiers, file paths and transcripts are removed before commit.
